about1: Our story began in 2024 with a simple dream and a big ambition: to offer authentic Middle Eastern cuisine with a genuine taste and quality we trust. We specialized in four main dishes that we consider the secret to our success: kofta, hawawshi, grilled liver, and shish kebab, and we served them in sandwiches with a consistent taste and unchanging quality. With the trust and support of our customers, we were able to grow step by step.
about2: Today we have two branches, and we're still going strong with the same passion and the same commitment to taste, cleanliness, and quality ingredients. Our goal is always to ensure that every sandwich arrives piping hot, perfectly prepared, and with the same delicious taste you love, because your satisfaction is the secret to our continued success.
about4: The success of any place doesn't just come from a good recipe, but starts with passionate people who love what they do and respect every detail. From day one, we relied on one cohesive team that works with a group spirit, and every member knows their role and responsibilities well. Our team isn't just employees; it's a group of people who have grown with the place, learned, developed themselves, and become an essential part of our journey. Every single member of the team has an important role.
about5: In the kitchen, we work with precision and focus to ensure the taste is consistent every time we prepare. We pay attention to the smallest details and the quality of materials in our service. We make sure that the service is respectful, fast, and worthy of the customer's trust over the years. We were able to build an integrated work system based on commitment, cooperation, and a love for the work. This is what enabled us to grow and open two branches without sacrificing the quality or spirit with which we started.
about6: We believe that true success is sustained when it's backed by a unified team working together. And every sandwich we make is the result of collective effort, crafted with dedication and respect for our customers' tastes.
